period_note: Half-Yearly filing (H1, cumulative Jan 1 - Jun 30 2026), stored in the Q2 slot. Consolidated basis (MTB-Solo incl. OBU & Islamic Banking, plus MTB Securities PLC + MTB Capital Limited). Fetched as a bonus extension of this session's MTB backfill; a clean text PDF (188 lines via pdftotext -layout). Same 'Bond' breakout as 2026_Q1.json applies: Perpetual Bond BDT 4,000m (unchanged) + Subordinated Debts BDT 3,960m = Bond total BDT 7,960m, stored combined in 'subordinated_debt' with 'perpetual_bond' as a supplementary line item. VALIDATION: Total Liabilities + Total Shareholders' Equity + Non-Controlling Interest (562,173,679,495+30,458,099,586+138,052=592,631,917,133) reproduces Total Property and Assets EXACTLY. Total Liabilities reconciles from components to within BDT 1: Borrowing(86,812,688,266) + Bond(7,960,000,000) + Deposits(401,559,188,448) + Other Liabilities(65,841,802,780) = 562,173,679,494 vs reported 562,173,679,495. P&L chain: Net Interest Income(677,097,694) + Total Other Income(9,651,040,033) = Total Operating Income(10,328,137,727) exactly; - Total Operating Expenses(6,107,843,410) = 4,220,294,317 vs reported Profit Before Provision 4,220,294,316 (BDT 1 rounding); - Total Provision(3,480,456,817) = 739,837,500 = Profit Before Tax exactly; - Provision for Taxation (a net TAX CREDIT: Current Tax Expenses 561,075,746 less Deferred Tax credit 889,449,761 = -328,374,015) = 739,837,500 - (-328,374,015) = 1,068,211,515 = Net Profit After Tax EXACTLY. Interest expense grew ~BDT 2,001m YoY 'due to growth in average deposits by BDT 51,782 million' per the report's own MD&A-style deviation note -- consistent with the large H1 2026 deposit and borrowing growth visible in this same balance sheet.
